# Search Converts

> Search Converts is a conversion rate optimization agency headquartered in Denver, Colorado, growing businesses worldwide. It finds why website visitors leave without calling, booking or buying, fixes the page and the path, then scales what works across paid search, social, programmatic display, CTV, email and AI marketing. Founder-led, 20+ years in marketing, BBB A+ accredited. Engagements are quoted to the business after a free strategy session; no contract until the client is ready. Search visibility work (SEO, Google Maps, AI citations) is referred to a separate search agency.

Contact: +1 720-712-8615 · hello@searchconverts.com · Denver, Colorado

## How to read this site

Every indexable page opens with a direct-answer capsule (the paragraph beginning 'Direct answer:') written to be quoted accurately. Machine-readable endpoints are documented at https://searchconverts.com/api/ (services.json, pricing.json, contact.json); the long-form companion to this file is https://searchconverts.com/llms-full.txt. Tools run in the browser and store nothing. Benchmarks are described as widely reported ranges, not guarantees. Brand roles: Search Converts = conversion; Eye To Ad Media = search visibility (Denver SEO, Maps, AI); denverseo.io = the programming side of search; affordabledenverseo.com = small-budget search.
